title: Code Reviews
seo: Code review for SaaS and web apps
meta: A written review of your code for quality, speed and security, with fixes ranked by priority. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Code review for quality, speed and security
overview: We read your code the way an experienced developer joining your team would. We check structure, readability, tests, speed hot spots and common security slips, then write up what we find in ranked order, with examples from your own files. You get a clear report you can hand to your team, plus a call to talk it through. Nothing is changed in your code unless you ask.

pkgs.blurb: A focused review of one area of your code.
A wider review including speed and common security checks.
A deep review with dependency checks, a fix plan and sample fixes.

faq: Do you need access to my whole repository?
Read access to the repository is enough, added as a collaborator. If some folders are sensitive, tell us which ones to skip and we review the rest. We never need your passwords.
Not unless you choose the top package, where we fix three findings as examples on a separate branch. Otherwise the review is a report and your team decides what to apply.
Can you review code written with AI tools?
Yes. We review it like any other code, and we often see the same patterns: repeated logic, missing checks and tests that only cover the happy path. We point those out with examples.
Is this a full security audit?
No. It is a code review with common security checks, not a penetration test or formal audit. If we spot something serious we tell you right away and suggest a specialist for deeper testing.
